insurer_name: The New India Assurance Co. Ltd.
sub_limits_waiting_notes: PED 36 months; specific disease waiting per IRDAI list. Cumulative bonus 25% per claim-free year up to 50%.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Indemnity cover up to SI; room/ICU caps applicable per plan; Zone-based premium and co-pay

day_care_treatments.limit_text: Listed day care procedures plus 12 Modern Treatments (robotic surgery, stem cell therapy, etc.)

domiciliary_treatment.limit_text: Domiciliary treatment subject to policy conditions and 3-day rule

ayush_coverage.limit_text: Up to 100% of Sum Insured for inpatient AYUSH

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Per emergency, up to limit defined in schedule

organ_donor_expenses.notes: Donor hospitalisation excluding cost of organ

newborn_coverage.notes: Newborn covered from birth until policy expiry if mother is continuously insured 24 months

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Critical illness benefit per IRDAI standardised list (cancer, MI, CABG, valve surgery, coma, kidney failure, stroke, organ transplant, paralysis, MND, MS)

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Health check-up reimbursement subject to continuous coverage

room_rent_capping: Per plan (typically 1% of SI per day for general, 2% ICU)
copayment_trigger_notes: 20% co-pay if Zone-2 insured opts treatment in Zone-1; not applicable to accident or sub-limited claims
notable_exclusions_summary: Cover restricted to India. Maternity, infertility, cosmetic, dental (non-accident), war and self-harm excluded. Zone-1 vs Zone-2 co-pay applies.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA in network hospital (1-hour pre-auth, 3-hour discharge approval). Reimbursement within 15 days of discharge. Intimation within 24 hours.
